$meta.name: uxproof application design system
$meta.scope: The Next.js web application in next/. The generated PowerPoint deck is a SEPARATE system defined in next/src/lib/branding/brand.ts — its tokens must never be used here, and these must never be used there.
$meta.notes: Values marked with a `source` are the shipping implementation. Semantic names in this file are a naming layer over that implementation, not a replacement for it — address colour in code through the Tailwind token utilities (bg-card, text-muted-foreground), never by hex.

changelog.1.1.0: Findings from v1.0 applied to the code. --muted-foreground darkened to clear 4.5:1 on card; the dark --destructive pair inverted and every raw red-*/rose-* utility migrated onto it; eleven unused tokens, three dead components and four unused primitives deleted (recharts dropped with the chart primitive); the default Button variant given a real hover. See color.destructive, accessibility.contrast and resolved.
changelog.1.0.0: First capture of the shipped system.

sunken.usage: Darkest ground. Used literally on the dashboard 'generate new' tile; the --sidebar token itself is unused.

default.usage: Cards, dialogs, dropdowns, popovers, the login form.

sunken.usage: Recessed fills: ghost-button hover, avatar fallback, code, table head. Usually applied at 30–60% alpha.

accent.usage: Reserved tint one step warmer than surface.sunken. Rarely used.

userBubble.usage: The user's own chat bubble — the only hard-coded surface in the app.

secondary.usage: Subtitles, metadata, timestamps, placeholders, inactive icons.
secondary.note: Darkened from #717182 in v1.1: the old value scored 4.49:1 against `card`, which is where most of it lands. This is the contrast floor of the palette — never lighten it, and never put it on `surface.sunken`.

inverse.usage: Tooltip text on the inverted tooltip ground.

default.usage: Every hairline. Violet-tinted, never neutral grey.

ring.usage: Card and DialogContent outline — a ring rather than a border.

primary.usage: The one filled action per view, the active nav item, the focus ring, progress fill.

secondary.usage: Low-emphasis filled control and the neutral badge.

ink.usage: Accent ink: the 'ux' in the wordmark, inline action icons, citation chips.

wash.usage: Selected rows, icon tiles, citation chips.

logomark.source: top-bar.tsx UxproofMark, app/icon.svg, lib/ppt-generator.ts cover mark
logomark.usage: The app tile and favicon — the identity's own flat violet, not a UI token. Was a 135° gradient (#8B75FF → #5B47D6) until the mark was redrawn; keep the component, the favicon and the deck cover mark in sync.

assistantGradient.usage: The assistant avatar tile — marks generated content, and nothing else.

success.usage: Completed steps, success toasts, the Ready badge. ICON-ONLY in light mode — 3.77:1 on white, which clears the 3:1 graphics threshold but not the 4.5:1 text threshold.

progress.usage: Running steps, streaming caret, generating spinner.

error.usage: The single danger colour: validation, failed steps, error toasts, error bubbles, delete affordances and the confirm button. Ink and solid fill alike; washes are destructive/5-/20.
error.note: Deliberately inverted between themes — dark mode needs danger to read as INK on #13131f, so the dark value is the light red and `destructive-foreground` is the dark ink that sits on it.

advisory.usage: Quick-action insight icons. ICON-ONLY in light mode — 3.19:1 on white.

onError.usage: Text on a solid destructive fill — the ConfirmDialog confirm button.

mono.usage: Machine facts and chrome only: extensions, period tags, durations, citation chips, uppercase group labels. Never prose.

weight.note: 600 is the ceiling in practice — font-bold appears nowhere in the app.

micro.usage: Context tags, sidebar metadata, citation chips.

assignment.containerPadding: 16px — anything with a border around it (card, dialog, top-bar gutter, message-row gap)
assignment.controlPadding: 10px horizontal inside buttons, inputs and select triggers
assignment.siblingGap: 24px — between message rows and deck cards

xs.usage: The clipped tail corner of a chat bubble — nothing else.

sm.usage: Inline code, tooltip, small inline chips.

md.usage: Dropdown items, icon tiles, pipeline rows, mode-switch tabs.

lg.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, textarea, select trigger, popover surfaces, session rows.

xl.usage: Containers: cards, dialogs, panels, chat bubbles, toasts.

full.usage: Badges, avatars, the composer pill, the send button, status dots.

width.note: The only border width in the application.

style.awaitingInput: dashed — the avatar drop target only

none.usage: In-page cards, file rows, message bubbles — flat by default.

sm.usage: Stat cards, login card, selected mode-switch tab.

drawer.usage: The history drawer, cast rightward onto the page.

shadow.rule: Never combine a shadow with a visible border on something that sits in the page flow.

toaster.anchor: top-16 right-4 — directly beneath the profile avatar

layout.alignment: Flush left everywhere. Centred only where there is no content to align to yet: login, welcome, empty states, the quick-action row.

motion.reducedMotion: Suppressed globally by @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) in globals.css and <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"> in app-shell.tsx. No animation may be the sole carrier of information.

rules: One filled (default) button per view or dialog.
Active navigation is expressed as ghost → default, not an underline or rail.
Destructive actions are ghost-tinted-red until confirmed; the only solid red button is the ConfirmDialog confirm.
A disabled button must carry a reason.
focus-visible ring is never removed or replaced.
Fix the cva recipe rather than adding a per-call-site hover, focus or state colour.

avatar.fallback: initials from display name or email local-part

card.footer: border-t + bg-muted/50, flush to the card edges

placement.anchored: Settings and Profile — top-16 right-3, hanging from the avatar

unused.note: Defined but not yet consumed — both are dependency-free and are the right thing to reach for rather than hand-rolling a divider or a bar. tabs/accordion/sheet/chart and the three dead product components were deleted in v1.1; recharts went with the chart primitive.

accessibility.claim: The product has NOT been formally evaluated against a WCAG conformance level. The ratios below are measurements of the shipped palette.
rules: Every text pair in the palette clears 4.5:1 in both themes. status.success and status.advisory are the two exceptions and are icon-only.
text.secondary on surface.default (5.06:1) is the contrast floor — never lighten it, and never put it on surface.sunken.
Colour is never the only signal for a state.
Hover-revealed actions must also respond to focus-within.
Every icon-only control carries an aria-label; tooltips supplement names, they never replace them.
knownGaps: Touch targets are 24-32px, below the 44x44 guidance.
Disabled controls explain themselves via the native title attribute, which is unreliable for assistive technology.
The sign-in mode switch has tablist/tab/aria-selected but no tabpanel, aria-controls or arrow-key navigation.
Streaming assistant replies are not announced in a live region.
There is no skip link past the fixed top bar.

resolved.1 - three reds: RESOLVED in v1.1. rose-* and red-* are gone from the app; every danger surface uses --destructive / --destructive-foreground. The only remaining rose value is one stop of the decorative deck-cover gradient.
resolved.2 - eleven dead tokens: RESOLVED in v1.1. All eight --sidebar-* tokens, --input-background and --switch-background deleted from both themes, along with the --color-sidebar-* mappings in @theme inline.
resolved.3 - dead components: RESOLVED in v1.1. presentation-download-button.tsx, ai-processing-state.tsx and pipeline-status.tsx deleted. PresentationPreview is the deck surface; AIThinkingPanel is the progress surface.
resolved.4 - unused primitives: RESOLVED in v1.1. ui/tabs.tsx, ui/accordion.tsx, ui/sheet.tsx and ui/chart.tsx deleted; recharts removed from package.json. Removing it also exposed `immer` as an undeclared direct dependency of the zustand store — now declared.
resolved.5 - primary button had no hover: RESOLVED in v1.1. The default variant's hover is no longer scoped to [a]; the two per-call-site overrides that existed to work around it were removed.
resolved.6 - dashboard gradients: SCOPED EXCEPTION, documented at the definition in dashboard.tsx and in CLAUDE.md. Decorative cover for a generated artefact only; the hue carries no meaning and must not spread to chrome, status, data or type.
resolved.7 - two heading systems: OPEN. The base layer styles bare h1/h2/h3 but every page headline sets `display text-3xl` explicitly. The base layer is the safety net; always set the role explicitly in components.
resolved.8 - duplicated password field: OPEN. PasswordInput is defined twice, in login-screen.tsx and profile-dialog.tsx, differing only by a bg-muted/30. Should be one component in components/ui/ with the panel fill as a prop.
